label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is "<!-- " + param.replace("-->", "") + " -->". Although the code attempts to strip the comment terminator ">--", it fails to handle HTML entity encodings (e.g., -->) of the delimiter. An attacker can submit entity-encoded delimiters which pass through the replace call unchanged, causing the browser to interpret them as actual terminators upon rendering, thereby executing the script inside the comment. The sanitizer does not neutralize the attacker-controlled data reaching the sink.

evidence.note: param sourced from request, sanitized via replace, then written to response writer without proper HTML encoding
